audit_items.proof_trace: The repayment invariant is enforced by an exact equality check (market.move:837: `coin.value() == inner.amount() + fee`) combined with the hot-potato pattern: `FlashLoan` has no `drop` ability and can only be destructured inside `market.move::repay_flash_loan`, making it impossible to skip or underpay. The pool balance strictly increases after each flash loan because the fee (always > 0, enforced at borrow on line 814 and post-referral on line 851) is routed through `increase_reserve_only`, which correctly increments both `cash` and `underlying_balance` (reserve.move:291-293).
